newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace shares up on share allotment plan.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace shares up on share allotment plan.

text.p: Shares of Nippon Lace Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning following the firm"s announcement last week that it would conduct a third-party allotment of new shares.
By 0043 GMT, Nippon Lace shares were up five yen at 340 in active trade. Turnover was 1.36 million shares.
Nippon Lace, a lace maker, said on Friday that it would conduct a third-party allotment of six million new shares at 590 yen per share.
The payment date is March 12, the company said.

The funds to be raised through the share allotment will be used to strengthen the financial health of the company, which is expected to post an uncovered loss of 921 million yen in the business year to March 31, 1997, Nippon Lace said.
